fields.Name: C1 -> S6.1
fields.Description: Gate G2.6 (phase 2, dataset C1, criterion S6.1): the C1 holdout is carved by decision date after the declared cutoff; 100% of stored holdout keys fall after it, 0 are in training, and at the reference's cutoff they equal its 1,205 test keys. The protocol declares 2024-01-01 to 2025-01-01; the keys are the snapshot manifest's locked-holdout rows, compared with fixtures/c1-corpus/c1_reference_test_keys.csv. The unit reader returns rows sorted by decision date, so a trailing fraction in read order equals the date carve on C1 and cannot fail this gate; the mutation is a substitute: it fails when DateCarvedCarver holds out the trailing fraction in row-id order instead of carving by date (holdout keys before the cutoff > 0).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 1,205 stored holdout keys, all on or after 2024-01-01, none in training, equal to the reference's 1,205 test keys.
